blocks.text: Fig. 17.6(a) mein resistor R ek AC source se jura hai. Instantaneous (us lamhe ka) voltage:
Circuit mein instantaneous current (Ohm's law se):
Yahan Iₒ = Vₒ/R current ki peak (maximum) qeemat hai.

Eqs. 17.10 aur 17.11 se pata chalta hai ke voltage aur current dono sine functions hain jo waqt ke saath badalte hain. Fig. 17.6(b) dikhati hai ke dono ek hi time (waqt) par zero, maximum aur minimum se guzarte hain; is liye kehte hain ke resistor mein V aur I in phase (ek hi phase mein) hain.

Fig. 17.6(c) mein resistance ke liye V⃗_R aur I⃗_R vectors parallel (ek hi taraf) banaye gaye hain, kyunke un mein koi phase difference nahi. Circuit AC ke raste mein jo opposition (rukawat) dalta hai, woh resistance hai:

blocks.alt: (a) AC source V ke saath loop mein resistor R. (b) Voltage V (green) aur current I (purple) waqt ke saath, pi aur 2 pi par aik saath zero aur aik saath peak: in phase. (c) Aik hi direction (simt) ke do parallel teer VR aur IR.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.6: (a) AC source se jura resistor R; (b) sirf resistance wale circuit mein V aur I in phase; (c) resistance ke liye VR aur IR vectors (kitab ki Figure 17.6 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Resistor mein kharch hone wali power current ke square par depend (munhasir) karti hai, is liye current DC ho ya AC, positive ho ya negative, farq nahi parta. Lekin jis AC ki maximum qeemat Iₒ ho, woh utni power nahi deta jitni Iₒ wala DC deta hai, kyunke AC har aadhe cycle mein sirf ek instant (lamha) ke liye Iₒ par hota hai. AC circuit mein resistor ki instantaneous power:

blocks.text_alt: P = VI or P = I²R or P = V²/R   (17.12)

blocks.text: Aur average power (⟨ ⟩ ka matlab average):
Yeh bhi sabit kiya ja sakta hai ke:
Yahan P watt mein, V volt mein, I ampere mein aur R ohm mein hai. Yaad rahe: Eq. 17.12 sirf tab theek hai jab V aur I in phase hon (jaise sirf resistor wale circuit mein).

blocks.text:
12 V AC doorbell (kitab mein is ki tasveer hai)
Kam voltage wala AC istemal karna zyada safe (mehfooz) hai aur electric shock (bijli ka jhatka) ka khatra kam karta hai.

blocks.title: Example 17.3
blocks.problem: 1 kW ka heating element 250 V AC supply se jora gaya hai. Supply se liya gaya current aur garam element ki resistance nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: P = 1 kW = 1000 W, V = 250 V
P = VI, is liye I = P/V

blocks.prompt: Sirf resistor wale AC circuit mein V aur I ka phase difference kitna hai?
blocks.explanation: Zero: dono in phase hain (ek saath zero, ek saath peak).

items: Resistor: I = Iₒ sin ωt, Iₒ = Vₒ/R; V aur I in phase.
P = VI = I²R = V²/R; average ⟨P⟩ = Iᵣₘₛ²R = IᵣₘₛVᵣₘₛ.
